source.value: Rippers Unmasked — The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Mirage Blitz — printed name retired ⛔)

summary.value: You command all your active Phantasms to charge at a single enemy with incredible speed, shattering on impact.

system.description: You command all your active Phantasms to charge at a single enemy with incredible speed, shattering on impact. They all share a single Magic Check. If they hit, the target suffers (HR + 10) physical damage per Phantasm and dazed. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances. This damage increases to 15 per Phantasm if you are level 20 or higher, or to 20 if you are level 40 or higher.
